name: class-test-31d1ee9eb5/simple-class-v.bal
spec_references: Module-level declarations: Class definition — Supports `object-field`, `method-defn` and `object-type-inclusion` members
Expressions: New expression; Mapping constructor; Field access expression; Type test expression; Conditional expression
Operators: Equality ops `==`, `!=`, `===`, `!==`; Logical ops `&&`, `||`; Additive ops `+`, `-`
Invocations / Other invocation restrictions: Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions: `value:toString` and `value:toBalString`
Statements: Assignment; Call; If/else; Local variable declarations; Return; Panic
reason: The case checks class field defaults, explicit and contextually inferred construction, class inclusion with inherited fields, initializer assignments, and class-valued record fields. These constructs are covered by the supported declarations and expressions. The assertion helper uses supported equality, type tests, conditionals, value:toString, and error construction/panic. Successful main execution requires every field assertion to pass; no unsupported behavior is essential.
test_design_notes: main invokes all four tests; there are no @args, @panic, or @output directives. Assertion failure panics; successful execution has no output.
